goal: Produce a horizontal or vertical minimalist image with a morning solitude meditation character, suitable as wallpaper for collaboration with a home aromatherapy brand.

mood.feeling: Quiet, can hear the light tapping sound of ceramics, not in a hurry to awaken at dawn
mood.one_sentence: Straighten the steam, then greet the world.

subject.description: Very simple handle white porcelain coffee cup viewed from 3/4 top down, with a very fine gold rim at the mouth, and steam rising slightly to the left in a straight line.
subject.scale: The oval at the cup's rim occupies about 11% of the image.
subject.position: Left-aligned in the middle upper, with the bottom right 2/3 left blank

background.type: Off-white matte with slight grain, almost no directional light
background.main_color: Off-white 92%, warm gold as the rim and steam core line 2%, the rest an extremely light warm gray shadow

text_overlay.text: Straighten the steam, then greet the world.
text_overlay.position: Lower right, aligned to the right
text_overlay.font_style: Very fine displayed mixed English serif, English is smaller when mixed with Chinese.

style.rendering: Digital paper texture, clean edges, steam depicted with two or three lines that are clear-cut.
style.lighting: No shadows, or only a light gray contact shadow at the bottom of the cup.
style.color_palette: No decorative colors outside of main and auxiliary colors.

must_keep: The white space area dominates the emotion, and the cup body is not centered.
No mobile phones, books, or hands
A core Chinese phrase, without tags or hashtags
avoid: Coffee latte art steals the spotlight
Make the scene a lively version of a breakfast stall
Text is formatted in multiple lines.
